semantic_findings.topic: Session defaults and actual request state
semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: newSession installs ClassicDependencyManager, scope(test/provided)+optional+exclusion selectors, FatArtifactTraverser, nearest/Java scope/optionality transforms and a type registry. Core factory replaces that registry with handler-manager lookup and adds request cache/settings/profile/system/user/workspace/repository state.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: A newSession helper and empty-property byte-model recipe do not recreate a stock project/descriptor/CLI session;no settings,cache,workspace,credentials or repository state is adopted.

semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: Project collection supplies a root artifact plus direct and managed dependencies. A root Dependency instead causes descriptor loading and merges request dependencies/management ahead of descriptor lists;different root forms affect child selector/manager contexts.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: Preserve per-owner roles and root/depth/order. A GAV data template cannot select a unique project/plugin/root context or prove field-origin provenance.

semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: Plugin requests use a plugin root Dependency, clone the session and add WagonExcluder. Declared plugin dependencies become runtime except system. A provided/test ScopeDependencyFilter is combined with caller filters for resolution;this is separate from collection selector depth handling.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: Packaged plugin.xml pools are not resolved trees or a transferable project classpath. Effective filter/core exports/provider/Mojo execution remains unqualified.

semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: Core extension coordinates are interpolated using request user/system properties and passed through resolveCoreExtension. Class-loading strategy/core exports affect realm imports and artifact inclusion before normal project goals.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: Retain build-cache1.2.0 and source bootstrap behavior. No extension/realm/CLI was loaded;plugin-like resolution does not confer ordinary project authority or safe exclusion.

semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: Classic manager captures root managed information and stops adding deeper lists;version/scope/optional management is depth gated,while managed exclusions are merged. PremanagedDependency records/replaces distinct fields before descriptor traversal. DefaultDependencyManager is a separate implementation,not the installed default merely because its class exists.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: Do not substitute transitive management or match a child owner management entry as consumer selection. Root management,pre-managed fields,depth and direct model defaults remain separate.

semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: Scope selector accepts direct dependencies before becoming transitive on a dependency-bearing child context;the configured test/provided exclusion is depth sensitive. Optional selector permits depth<2 and otherwise rejects optional dependencies. And selector composes child selectors.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: Do not discard all test/provided/optional declarations. Root shape,call path and model/collector semantics must be qualified per role before any graph is pruned.

semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: Selector compares groupId/artifactId/extension/classifier with exact-or-star matching and accumulates exclusions in child contexts. Maven model exclusions convert group/artifact to wildcard extension/classifier.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: The prior363 incoming GA matches remain candidate data;consumer management,normalization,relocation and selector path are required before a resolved exclusion/effect claim.

semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: Scope derivation distinguishes child system/test,parent compile/empty,parent test/runtime,parent provided/system and fallback. Conflict scope/optionality selection is a separate stage,with direct dependency treatment. Winning version alone does not determine selected scope or optionality.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: No scope matrix or optional propagation is applied to candidate paths;full conflict group/root/depth inputs remain missing.

semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: Conflict keys use actual group/artifact/extension/classifier and include relocation/alias keys. Groups are ordered before conflict resolution. NearestVersionSelector honors range constraints/backtracking;among siblings it prefers a higher version,otherwise lower depth,with iteration order retained when no candidate is nearer.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: No global GAV winner or generic first-declaration rule. Raw type comparison keys are not actual resolver identity.108 cross-template families and original9 realm families remain unmediated.

semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: Dependency type has a jar model default;scope compile is not a simple MDO field default and is injected after management by the previously pinned model normalizer. Core converts through an artifact-handler registry. Stock test-jar maps to extension jar/classifier tests;unknown handler types fall back to type-as-extension and default handler attributes. Extensions can contribute handlers.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: Stock source mapping is evidence only;not actual installed realm registry,classifier selection or output equivalence. Keep raw nulls/literals in old frontiers. Packaging bundle does not establish a bundle dependency type.

semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: FatArtifactTraverser gates traversal on includesDependencies. DefaultDependencyCollector selects df unless session config chooses a delegate;both df/bf sources are retained. Df applies management,range/descriptor processing,cycle recording and relocation reprocessing before recursion.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: No collector was run. Traversal omission,classpath properties or no cycle in available templates is not binary/provider/effect isolation or full cycle clearance.

semantic_findings.observed_source_semantics: Exact version and range handling differ. Range resolution can combine local/remote repository metadata and workspace versions under repository/config policies. Relocations can re-enter collection and alter version-management handling. Existing descriptor reader source also has relocation/model/session behavior absent from the byte diagnostic.
semantic_findings.qualification_limit: Three original ranges and two Quarkus relocations remain unapplied. No live metadata/version selection,range guess,redirect,repository discovery or automatic relocation follow is authorized.
